certifiedResults.countyCrosswalk: 2024 Hawaii numbered precinct names map House districts 01-08 to Hawaii County, 09-14 to Maui County, 15-17 to Kauai County, and 18-51 to Honolulu County. Kalawao is not a separate result county in the official detail export.

reviewCharts.warning: Hawaii review rows are same-grain President-versus-U.S.-Senate precinct/split rows from the official Office of Elections media.txt export. The parser excludes three zero-vote non-geographic President keys (PRES, OS I, OS II) from advisory rows; numbered precinct/split review rows aggregate to the certified statewide presidential total. County labels are derived from the official numbered precinct district ranges and should be treated as a reproducible crosswalk, not precinct-boundary geometry. Advisory rows are public-interest source-review signals only, not findings of fraud or misconduct.

turnout.notes: Hawaii turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until the Hawaii Office of Elections registration/turnout table is normalized and reconciled. The state-native table reports 522,236 statewide turnout and 860,868 registered voters, but county registered-voter distribution and Kalawao handling need review before replacing EAC fallback.
